title: just-deliver release set
description: Generated by `jd release create`, never edited: the snapshot the platform keeps of a release (ADR 0007). Each workload definition is embedded as received, so the set is self-contained, and carries the SHA-256 of its exact bytes. Name, team, image and deploy order are not stored: loading derives them from the definitions with the rules `create` applies, so each has one source.

createdAt.description: UTC time the set was created, to the second.

definitionSha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 over the exact bytes of the definition file.

dependsOn.description: Names (metadata.name) of workloads in this set that deploy first.

definition.description: The definition file content as received (UTF-8). Hashed exactly; a leading byte order mark is part of the hash but not of the parsed YAML.
